channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Defesa de Bolsonaro se reúne com Moraes e reitera pedido de domiciliar
item.description: Jair Bolsonaro's lawyer, Paulo Cunha Bueno, met with Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes to reiterate the request for maintaining Bolsonaro's humanitarian house arrest, citing health conditions and denying that the firearm found at his residence constitutes a serious violation. The initial 90-day period of house arrest ended on June 25, and Moraes will decide whether to maintain or revoke the measure pending the outcome of the firearm investigation.

item.title: STF retomará em agosto o julgamento sobre a eleição no Rio de Janeiro
item.description: The STF will resume in August its judgment on the Rio de Janeiro gubernatorial election, after Minister Flávio Dino’s request for vista was suspended and now returned. The case stems from successive resignations by Cláudio Castro, Thiago Pampolha, and Rodrigo Bacellar, leading to the interim assumption of office by Ricardo Couto. The PSD advocates for a direct election, while a majority of justices voted for indirect election, split on whether the vote should be secret or open.

item.title: Democracia voltou a ser ameaçada no mundo todo, diz Lula
item.description: President Lula stated that democracy is under threat globally and in South America, citing the January 8 events as an attempted coup in Brazil. He emphasized Mercosur's historical role in defending democracy, criticized disinformation, and affirmed that popular will and democratic rules have prevailed despite challenges.

item.title: Presidente do Paraguai credita Lula por acordo Mercosul-UE
item.description: Paraguayan President Santiago Peña credited Brazilian President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva for the conclusion of the Mercosul-European Union trade agreement, praising Lula as a permanent force of integration over two decades. Peña expressed regret over Lula's absence at the agreement's signing ceremony in January and urged him to continue as a pillar of regional unity, emphasizing justice in trade for smaller, landlocked nations. The 68th Mercosul Summit took place in Asunción with all bloc leaders present except Argentine President Javier Milei.

item.title: Não é só Tarcisio x Haddad: quem são as três mulheres que querem governar São Paulo
item.description: The race for governor of São Paulo is polarized between Tarcísio de Freitas (Republicanos) and Fernando Haddad (PT), who together account for nearly 80% of voting intentions. Three women — Vera Lúcia (PSTU), Izadora Dias (PCO), and Vivian Mendes (UP) — are presenting themselves as pre-candidates, but have not been included in recent polls due to lack of official registration and their parties' absence from Congress, which also excludes them from media debates.

item.title: Dino destrava ação no STF sobre eleições no Rio
item.description: Minister Flávio Dino completed his analysis and returned the case records to the STF in a lawsuit discussing the election model for the government of Rio de Janeiro, currently under the rapporteurship of Judge Ricardo Couto. The decision advances the judicial process on electoral rules in the state, with potential impact on the 2026 elections. The article is exclusive to subscribers of the originating outlet.

item.title: Depois de receber Flávio na Argentina, Milei esnoba cúpula do Mercosul
item.description: After hosting Brazilian senator and 2026 presidential pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) at the Olivos residence, Argentine President Javier Milei skipped the Mercosul summit, sparking speculation about his distancing from the regional bloc. The meeting with Bolsonaro underscores the growing ideological alignment between the two right-wing leaders. Milei’s absence from the Mercosul gathering was widely interpreted as a signal prioritizing bilateral alliances over multilateral commitments.

item.title: Lula manda recado a Trump em reunião do Mercosul: 'Ninguém é dono da América do Sul'
item.description: Lula criticized the notion that any country 'owns South America' during a Mercosul meeting in Paraguay, advocating for regional autonomy and dialogue with all nations. He also promoted the Pix payment system as a global model of financial inclusion and proposed its adoption across the bloc to reduce costs and strengthen intrabloc trade.

item.title: Tarcísio entrega estação da Linha 17: "Prometida para Copa de 2014"
item.description: Governor Tarcísio de Freitas inaugurated the Washington Luís station on Line 17-Gold of the São Paulo Metro, completing the line's 'Y' format and making it the first in the system with three terminal destinations: Morumbi, Congonhas, and Washington Luís. The new station adds 800 meters of track and requires passengers to transfer at Brooklin Paulista station to reach the new terminal, preserving the 'shuttle' format on other segments. The inauguration follows multiple operational failures on the line since its opening.

item.title: Alcolumbre mantém pressão sobre governo com votação de pauta-bomba
item.description: Davi Alcolumbre scheduled a vote on a PEC granting special retirement to community health agents, with a R$30 billion impact over 10 years, putting the government on alert. Lula authorized R$520 million for electoral propaganda — more than double Bolsonaro’s 2022 spending — while the PSD is set to announce Kassab as Caiado’s running mate this Wednesday, following pressure from the party’s founders. Meanwhile, the Instituto Conhecer Brasil, linked to Karina Gama, reported R$54 million in revenue in 2025, raising suspicions of public fund misappropriation.

item.title: Crusoé: Ricardo Salles nega intenção de substituir Romeu Zema
item.description: Federal deputy Ricardo Salles denied having any intention to replace Romeu Zema as the Novo party’s presidential candidate in 2026, stating that Zema remains the party’s nominee and that he himself is still running for the Senate in São Paulo. He suggested that strategic adjustments may be needed to improve Zema’s electoral viability.

item.title: Marília Ruiz fala sobre queda alemã: "Não vence mata-mata desde 7 x 1"
item.description: Marília Ruiz commented on Germany's elimination from the 2026 World Cup, noting the team has not won a knockout match since their 7-1 loss to Brazil in 2014. Germany lost to Paraguay on penalties (4-3) after a 1-1 draw in regular time, extending their negative streak in knockout games.

item.title: Crises na pré-campanha de Flávio atrasam articulações do PL nos estados
item.description: Crises in Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign — involving allegations of irregular financing for the film 'Dark Horse' and tensions with Michelle Bolsonaro — are delaying the PL's state-level candidate selections, particularly in Rio de Janeiro, where the party awaits a decision on the Senate seat vacated by Cláudio Castro. Party officials admit that time and energy spent managing internal conflicts are undermining the development of competitive state slates, with a decision expected this Friday, the 3rd, when Flávio visits Rio.

item.title: Oposição pressiona Lula com propostas linha-dura para segurança pública
item.description: Brazilian opposition is pressuring President Lula with hardline public security proposals, inspired by mass incarceration, to exploit growing voter concern over violence, which 30% cite as the top national issue. The debate intensified after the lethal police operation in Rio de Janeiro in October 2023 and the U.S. designation of Brazilian criminal factions as 'terrorists,' introducing a sovereignty element that polarizes the electorate between nationalists and internationalists. Lula aims to appear firm on security without seeming lenient, while the opposition seeks to reduce his frontrunner status by making this a central theme in the 2026 presidential pre-campaign.

item.title: Lula lança Plano Safra de R$ 525 bilhões para a agricultura empresarial; veja os principais números
item.description: President Lula launched the 2026/27 Harvest Plan with R$ 525.1 billion, an increase of R$ 9 billion from the previous cycle. The package allocates R$ 384.9 billion for financing and commercialization and R$ 140.2 billion for investments, including R$ 72.6 billion for Pronamp targeting medium-sized rural producers. Announced ahead of the 2026 elections, the plan underscores the government’s support for agribusiness.

item.title: Lula pede 1 minuto de silêncio pela Venezuela em cúpula do Mercosul
item.description: President Lula requested a minute of silence for Venezuela during the Mercosul summit in Asunción, honoring victims of the June 24 earthquake that has caused over 1,400 deaths and 60,000 disappearances. He emphasized international solidarity and confirmed Brazil’s humanitarian aid flights carrying medical supplies and field hospital materials, without affecting SUS reserves.

item.title: Crusoé: Pesquisa indica impacto de vídeo de Michelle para Flávio
item.description: A BTG/Nexus poll revealed that Michelle Bolsonaro's video had a negative impact on Flávio Bolsonaro's pre-campaign, increasing his rejection among female voters from 56% to 58% between June 12 and 14. The result suggests that the communication strategy involving the former first lady may have harmed the image of the PL pre-candidate among female voters.

item.title: Sucessão e lealdade: As duas perguntas da pesquisa AtlasIntel que tiram o sono de Flávio e Michelle
item.description: The AtlasIntel poll raises two critical questions for the Bolsonaro family: who Jair Bolsonaro’s voters prefer as the 2026 presidential candidate (Flávio, Michelle, or neither), and who is seen as more loyal to the ex-president’s political line. Released after Michelle’s video accusing Flávio of humiliation, the survey highlights the family’s internal rift and the weakness of Bolsonarism among female voters, who constitute 52.5% of the Brazilian electorate.

item.title: Governo Lula propõe que população escolha destino de emendas e contrata mais atrito com Congresso
item.description: The Lula government proposes directing parliamentary amendments to a participatory budget, allowing citizens to decide how public funds are spent, with the possibility of canceling amendments if lawmakers agree. The initiative, submitted via official letter to Congress to amend the 2027 Budget Guidelines Law, faces resistance even within the ruling coalition, with critics warning of legislative overreach and supporters praising democratic budgeting. In 2026, parliamentary amendments are projected to reach R$ 50 billion, representing 20% of the Union’s total spending on investment and public administration maintenance.

item.title: Valdemar se reúne com Michelle após vídeo sobre Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL, met with Michelle Bolsonaro to ease family tensions after videos surfaced in which she accused Flávio Bolsonaro of humiliating and mistreating her. The meeting followed Flávio's apology and Valdemar's statement emphasizing party unity despite internal disagreements.

item.title: STF tem 3 votos para anular doação de fiel à Igreja Universal
item.description: The Brazilian Supreme Federal Court has three votes (Edson Fachin, Cármen Lúcia, and Alexandre de Moraes) to reject a plea from the Universal Church of the Kingdom of God seeking to overturn a ruling that requires it to return donations made by a follower under claims of irresistible moral coercion and abuse of right. The virtual plenary vote ends on August 5. Minas Gerais courts ruled the donations were made under religious pressure, undermining the donor’s free will, and ordered the church to repay R$229,100 in material damages and R$12,000 in moral damages, plus interest and adjustment.

item.title: Inscrições para curso de formação de candidatas às Eleições 2026 terminam hoje, terça-feira (30)
item.description: Registrations for the 30th edition of the Electoral Candidates Course - Brazil Edition close today, Tuesday (30). Supported by the TSE and organized by the CIM/OEA, OEA School of Government, and Anadep, the initiative will select up to 580 women for hybrid training, including in-person sessions in Brasília on July 8-9 and a virtual session on July 17, aiming to strengthen women's political participation and cover topics such as women's rights and gender equity in the electoral process.

item.title: Crusoé: Kassab encontrou um vice para Caiado?
item.description: Gilberto Kassab, national president of the PSD party, is set to meet with pre-candidate Ronaldo Caiado to finalize the presidential ticket, with Kassab being named as Caiado's running mate. Kassab had previously been speculated as a potential vice-presidential candidate for Tarcísio de Freitas.

item.title: Casemiro vai do inferno ao céu entre torcedores nas redes: 'nunca critiquei'
item.description: Midfielder Casemiro scored two goals in Brazil's victory over Japan, avoiding elimination from the 2026 World Cup. His performance sparked an instant shift in social media reactions, with fans moving from prior criticism to enthusiastic praise within seconds. Casemiro emphasized that he had never criticized the coaching staff or his teammates.

item.title: JOTA Principal: Flávio Bolsonaro concentra esforços no Sudeste e tenta conter desgastes
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro is focusing his campaign on the Southeast to recover lost ground following controversies involving his dispute with Michelle Bolsonaro and a controversial video. He is seeking alliances with local leaders, such as São Paulo Governor Tarcísio de Freitas, and plans to launch his candidacy in São Paulo in late July, while the Northeast remains on the radar but with lower priority due to higher rejection rates.

item.title: Boulos diz que América Latina não aceitará ser “quintal de ninguém”
item.description: Guilherme Boulos, Minister of the General Secretariat of the Presidency, stated that Latin America will not accept being anyone's 'backyard', calling for unified regional action to defend sovereignty against external pressures, particularly from the United States. He criticized Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for allegedly placing Brazilian institutions at the service of U.S. interests, suggesting such conduct would be considered treason in the U.S.

item.title: Governo anuncia R$ 525 bilhões para o agronegócio e muda regras do crédito rural
item.description: The federal government announced the 2026/2027 Harvest Plan with R$ 525.1 billion for agribusiness financing, an increase of R$ 9 billion from the previous cycle. The plan allocates R$ 414.7 billion for financing and commercialization and R$ 110.3 billion for investments, alongside new rules banning subsidized credit for projects that suppress native vegetation and requiring transparency in fund origins. President Lula did not attend the launch, which was led by Vice President Geraldo Alckmin, due to his trip to the Mercosul Summit in Paraguay.

item.title: Renan Santos aciona Justiça para que débitos tributários contra ele deixem de ser públicos
item.description: Presidential pre-candidate Renan Santos (Missão) has filed a lawsuit in the Federal Court of São Paulo to halt the public disclosure of R$1.17 million in tax debts linked to Martin Artefatos de Metais S.A., where he was a shareholder-administrator from 2010 to 2020. His legal team argues he formally withdrew from the company in October 2020 and that the debts pertain to 1998–2003, a period when he had no involvement, claiming the continued public association with these obligations causes unjust reputational and financial harm.

item.title: Ao vivo: Lula participa da 68ª Cúpula do Mercosul
item.description: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva is attending the 68th Mercosul Summit in Asunción, Paraguay, where he is expected to announce an increase in Brazil’s contribution to the Focem from US$70 million to US$100 million annually over 10 years. The summit will also address regional integration, the bloc’s trade agenda, and the launch of negotiations with Japan, with Brazilian Minister Tomé Franca (Ports and Airports) in attendance.

item.title: PT acionará Flávio e PL na Justiça após carta de Rubio sobre transição
item.description: The Workers' Party (PT) will file two legal actions against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) and the Liberal Party, citing a letter from U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio as evidence of an alleged exchange of Brazilian classified data for foreign electoral support. One action requests a criminal investigation by the PGR for passive corruption, breach of official secrecy, and crimes against national sovereignty; the other, filed with the Electoral Public Ministry, alleges the PL’s subordination to the U.S. government and violation of electoral law banning foreign aid in campaigns.

item.title: Caiado anunciará Kassab como vice em chapa do PSD na disputa pela Presidência
item.description: Ronaldo Caiado, the PSD's pre-candidate for President, will announce Gilberto Kassab, the party's national president, as his running mate in a pure PSD ticket. The decision follows failed attempts to ally with União Brasil and PP, leading to a strategy of strengthening the ticket with internal party figures. The official announcement will take place in Brasília on Wednesday, after a meeting in São Paulo to finalize details.

item.title: Kassab será anunciado como vice de Caiado na 4ª feira
item.description: The national president of the PSD, Gilberto Kassab, will be announced as the vice-presidential candidate on Ronaldo Caiado's (PSD) ticket next Wednesday (July 1st) in Brasília. The decision follows the PSD's failure to secure an alliance for the vice-presidential nomination, aiming to unify the party and strengthen its national campaign structure. Caiado currently polls between third and fourth place in presidential vote intention surveys.

item.title: Lula gasta mais que o dobro de Bolsonaro em 2022 com propaganda do governo
item.description: In the first half of 2026, the Lula (PT) government allocated 520 million reais to the Secretariat of Social Communication (Secom), more than double Bolsonaro's government propaganda spending in 2022, according to Folha de S.Paulo. The increase occurs during an election year, as Lula seeks his fourth presidential term.

item.title: Senado vota pauta-bomba com impacto de R$ 30 bi sobre as contas públicas
item.description: The Senate is set to vote on Tuesday on PEC 14/2021, which would grant special retirement benefits to Community Health Agents and Epidemic Combat Agents, with an estimated fiscal impact of R$30 billion over the next ten years. The initiative, led by Senate President Davi Alcolumbre, represents a political test in his relationship with the Lula government and reflects growing fiscal pressure in an election year. Meanwhile, the U.S. Supreme Court shielded Federal Reserve Governor Lisa Cook from immediate dismissal by Trump, preserving the Fed’s independence despite Justice Department allegations of mortgage fraud.

item.title: E o sonho continua (por Marcos Magalhães)
item.description: Brazil's victory over Japan in the World Cup sparked optimism, but the text warns of internal and international challenges, including foreign interference attempts in the 2026 elections. It criticizes the Bolsonaro family's alignment with U.S. interests, particularly Flávio Bolsonaro's offer of a transition team to Secretary of State Marco Rubio.

item.title: Valdemar tenta conter crise entre Michelle e Flávio Bolsonaro, mas encontra resistência
item.description: PL president Valdemar Costa Neto is attempting to mediate the growing rift between Michelle Bolsonaro and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, but faces resistance as Michelle remains firm and has reportedly considered leaving politics. While the PL maintains Flávio as its official presidential candidate, allies speculate Michelle could replace him if he becomes untenable due to investigations like the Caso Master. Valdemar warns that internal division would weaken the party in the 2026 elections and worsen Jair Bolsonaro’s political and legal situation.

item.title: Freiras viralizam comemorando virada do Brasil: 'Pedimos intercessão de São Padre Pio, de quem Ancelotti é devoto'
item.description: Nuns from the Monastery of Santa Maria dos Anjos in Dourados (MS) went viral on social media after celebrating Brazil’s win over Japan in the World Cup, waving flags, cheering, and hugging. They said they only watch matches during special occasions like the World Cup and pray for the intercession of saints, including Saint Padre Pio, due to coach Ancelotti’s devotion. Mother Maria Rafaela explained their joy is natural, rooted in family football traditions, despite their cloistered life.

item.title: "Defeca pela boca", diz Thronicke após Figueiredo atacar voto feminino
item.description: Senator Soraya Thronicke (PSB-MT) responded to misogynistic attacks by influencer Paulo Figueiredo, who criticized women's voting and attacked Michelle Bolsonaro, saying he 'defecates through his mouth' and announced a request to the PGR to ban his public communication. Thronicke defended that gender-based violence affects all women, regardless of the target, and emphasized that attacking Michelle is an attack on all women.

item.title: PSD deve anunciar Kassab como vice de Caiado nesta quarta
item.description: The PSD is set to announce Gilberto Kassab as the vice-presidential candidate on Ronaldo Caiado's ticket for the 2026 elections, following a meeting between the two on Tuesday (30). The announcement is expected on Wednesday (1st) in Brasília, aiming to avoid a pure-party ticket and strengthen Caiado's bid, who currently polls around 3% and seeks to establish himself as a third-way alternative.

item.title: Os novos recados de Michelle Bolsonaro a Flávio e sua turma
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro posted biblical messages on Instagram aimed at her stepson Flávio Bolsonaro and allies of the presidential pre-candidate, particularly influencer Paulo Figueiredo, who has intensified attacks against her. She asserted she is on the 'right side of history' in response to the criticism. The posts reflect an escalating conflict within the Bolsonarist circle.

item.title: Ajax acerta contratação de Caio Henrique junto ao Monaco
item.description: Brazilian left-back Caio Henrique, 28, has been sold by Monaco to Ajax of the Netherlands for an initial fee of €11 million, with up to €3 million in performance-related bonuses. The player, who joined Monaco from Atlético Madrid in 2020 for €8 million, made 211 appearances, scored three goals and provided 39 assists for the Ligue 1 side, and earned five caps for Brazil. The transfer was announced by Monaco on Tuesday, following a thigh injury that sidelined him from March to May and prevented him from competing for a spot in Carlo Ancelotti’s 2026 World Cup squad.

item.title: Costa do Marfim e Noruega decidem nesta terça o próximo adversário do Brasil na Copa
item.description: Brazil will learn its next Round of 16 opponent on Tuesday, as Ivory Coast and Norway face off in Dallas at 2 p.m. (Brasilia time). Both teams finished the group stage with two wins and one loss, with Norway's Erling Haaland scoring four goals and Ivory Coast's Yan Diomande leading the attack. The winner will play Brazil on Sunday, July 5, at 5 p.m. in New Jersey.

item.title: 'Pesadelo da Alemanha' e Holanda dominada por sensação africana: a noite da queda de dois grandes na Copa
item.description: Germany and the Netherlands were eliminated in the round of 16 of the 2026 FIFA World Cup after losing penalty shootouts to Paraguay and Morocco, respectively. Germany, a four-time world champion, had not advanced past the group stage since 2014 and suffered its first-ever penalty shootout loss in World Cup history. The Netherlands also fell to Morocco after a 1-1 draw in regulation and extra time, while Brazil advanced by defeating Japan 2-1.

item.title: Governo lança Plano Safra empresarial e familiar nesta 3ª feira
item.description: The federal government launched the 2026/2027 Harvest Plan, allocating over R$ 608 billion in rural credit for medium and large producers and family farming, though below sector expectations. The announcement was split: at 10 a.m. for agribusiness, led by Vice President Geraldo Alckmin and Agriculture Minister André de Paula, and at 5 p.m. for small producers, with President Lula expected to attend after returning from Paraguay. Despite being a record amount, the plan fell short of the R$ 652 billion requested by ministries and the R$ 623–674 billion range sought by the productive sector.

item.title: Feminicídios caem em maio em SP, mas acumulado do ano segue em alta
item.description: In May 2026, São Paulo state recorded 18 femicide cases, a decrease from 26 cases in the same month of 2025. However, the government of Tarcísio de Freitas notes that the year-to-date total remains higher than last year. The state administration attributes the monthly decline to strengthened public security policies.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro ameaça não ser candidata ao Senado e abandonar a política
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro threatens to withdraw her Senate candidacy and abandon politics following tensions with her son, Senator Flávio Bolsonaro. She is meeting today with Valdemar Costa Neto, president of the PL party, to seek a de-escalation of family and partisan conflict. The exclusive article highlights the risk of a rift within the Bolsonaro family ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: Governo Trump vai 'tensionar' eleições no Brasil por medo da China, diz especialista que mapeou direita na América Latina
item.description: Regiane Bressan, professor of International Relations at Unifesp, claims that the United States, under Donald Trump’s influence, will 'tension' Brazil’s 2026 elections, as it does across Latin America, to counter leftist advances. This view follows recent right-wing victories in the region, such as Keiko Fujimori’s win in Peru and Abelardo de la Espriella’s in Colombia, both fueled by security and anti-narcotics rhetoric. While Bressan cites distrust in traditional politics, social media influence, and demand for quick solutions as drivers of the conservative shift, she identifies the U.S. as the common denominator behind the region’s ideological alignment.

item.title: ADPF 1339: as mulheres trans e a cota de gênero nas eleições
item.description: ADPF 1339 challenges the inclusion of trans women and travestis in Brazil’s electoral gender quota, but the STF, TSE, and Inter-American Court of Human Rights have already established gender as self-declared, guaranteeing rights like name and gender correction in civil registries. Requiring trans women to run under the male quota contradicts their legal identity and disregards evolving constitutional protections for fundamental rights and equality.

item.title: Eleições: apresentadores têm até esta terça para deixar rádio e TV
item.description: TV and radio presenters planning to run in the 2026 elections must leave their programs by June 30, as required by election law and TSE rules, to prevent unfair advantage from media exposure. Among those who have already stepped down are Silvia Abravanel (PSD, SP), José Luiz Datena (PSB), Sikêra Júnior (invited by Tarcísio de Freitas), and André Marinho (Novo, RJ), who have announced or are articulating candidacies for federal deputy, Congress, or governor of Rio de Janeiro.

item.title: Valdemar tem encontro com Michelle Bolsonaro para selar paz com Flávio
item.description: Valdemar Costa Neto, national president of the PL, will meet with Michelle Bolsonaro to mediate the conflict between her and Flávio Bolsonaro, following her public claim that he humiliated and disrespected her in a phone conversation about PL alliances in Ceará. The meeting aims to preserve party unity and prevent the feud from undermining Flávio’s electoral performance, particularly among female voters where Michelle holds sway. Despite the tension, Valdemar reaffirmed his support for Flávio’s 2026 presidential bid and ruled out any discussion of replacing him.
